items.author: Takeshi Hiratsuka, Salesforce Data & AI Architect, Tableau Ambassador 2026, Nov 22
items.summary: Side-by-side of a Tableau Next Data App and a Tableau Next Dashboard on Superstore. The Data App (map, KPI tiles, regional heat table, profit calculator) looks far richer, and he says Tableau Next's earlier expression limits now seem overcome. 6 reactions.

items.author: Eric Summers, 2x Tableau Ambassador, rebuilds Tableau dashboards as data apps, Nov 22
items.summary: "Studio or Data Apps?" infographic: Studio brings the agent into Tableau (native dashboards, any Creator can maintain); Data Apps bring Tableau into your agent (custom web app via Tableau MCP, someone must own the code). Same governed data either way. 36 reactions, 4 comments, 2 reposts.

items.author: Shai Karmani, Modern Analytics Leader, Microsoft Fabric & Power BI, Nov 19
items.summary: With Fabric Apps now GA, he turned a real Power BI semantic model into a browser VR room built with an AI agent, with a 16-minute guide and project linked. 17 reactions, 5 comments, 2 reposts.

items.author: Lukas Reese, Helps BI teams build Power BI reports through AI workflows, Nov 22
items.summary: Full walkthrough video of his Claude-based Power BI build workflow using the Power BI Report CLI skill and Tabular Editor. 55 reactions, 7 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Maya Mukhamedzhanova, Head of Growth Marketing, ex-Google, Nov 21
items.summary: Her startup dropped a $900/yr Tableau Creator license for a Claude-built marketing analytics web app (spend, funnel, retention, MRR; sample data). A sign of the "vibe-coded BI" pressure on licensed tools. 0 reactions.

items.author: Michalis (Mike) Konstantoulakis, Director of BI & Insights at efood, Nov 22
items.summary: The stakeholder test: if someone can't tell in about 10 seconds whether a KPI is good or bad, redesign it. Add context (targets, prior period), visual hierarchy, and less cognitive load. 12 reactions.

items.author: Harnham
items.summary: Director of Enterprise Data — Harnham (for a large not-for-profit healthcare system) — Remote, US (CA/NY/HI/ND/OR/RI/WA/WY residents ineligible) — posted 3 days ago — $265K–$300K + bonus — Director; leads ~60 people in data engineering and analytics engineering. Snowflake/cloud data platform strategy, governance and lineage, AI-ready data products, a shift from dashboards to conversational AI. 12+ yrs, 7+ in leadership; quarterly travel to Dallas. Leans toward data engineering more than BI.
